title: Rear Seat Comfort and Space
summary: Feedback about the G70's rear seating centers on comfort and passenger space, with many other mentions simply referencing rear-seat features or areas without clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the rear seat for being very comfortable, spacious, and generally impressive for passengers.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on rear-seat usability issues, including difficult child-seat setup due to rear headrests and a vague complaint about the rear seat back and dash panel.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention rear-seat legroom, pillows, TVs, screens, reclining, visibility, and general rear-seat references without enough clarity to assign a clear sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled mentions are undetermined, limiting confidence about the balance of specific rear-seat opinions.
Some examples mix seat comfort and space with rear-seat electronics or interior components, so the topic is somewhat broad rather than fully uniform.
One negative example is too terse to identify the exact issue with confidence.
